targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_worker_heartbeats WHERE health_state = 'healthy'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_worker_heartbeats WHERE is_stale = true
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stream_consumer_lag_snapshots WHERE pressure_state = 'critical' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM duplicate_event_reports WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT service_name) FROM degraded_mode_events WHERE event_type = 'entered' AND service_name NOT IN (SELECT service_name FROM degraded_mode_events WHERE event_type = 'cleared')
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'passed') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) FROM recovery_validation_runs
SELECT health_state, COUNT(*) as count FROM system_worker_heartbeats GROUP BY health_state
SELECT DISTINCT ON (consumer_group, topic) consumer_group || ':' || topic as group_topic, lag_count FROM stream_consumer_lag_snapshots ORDER BY consumer_group, topic, id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT DISTINCT ON (backend) backend, ROUND(retention_pressure_pct::numeric, 1) as pct FROM storage_pressure_snapshots ORDER BY backend, id DESC
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) as time, AVG(lag_count) as avg_lag FROM stream_consumer_lag_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as duplicates FROM duplicate_event_reports WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT consumer_group, topic, state, current_retry_count, retry_budget_limit, max_events_per_second FROM replay_throttle_states ORDER BY state DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT service_name, degraded_reason, event_type, auto_cleared, created_at FROM degraded_mode_events ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT scenario, status, passed_checks, total_checks, trace_propagation_ok, replay_idempotency_ok, completed_at FROM recovery_validation_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT 'duplicate_reports_protected' as check_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE analytics_protected = false) as violations FROM duplicate_event_reports UNION ALL SELECT 'degraded_no_auto_clear', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_cleared = true) FROM degraded_mode_events WHERE event_type = 'cleared'
